author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/30/2018: ANBA,WDAY,ASYS
text:
CSCO +0.05%
GOOG -0.04%
Technology stocks were slightly softer in Friday's pre-market, with sector heavyweights Microsoft ( MSFT ) and Apple ( AAPL ) fractionally lower in early trading.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Ambarella ( AMBA ) was more than 13% higher in Friday's pre-market after the specialty chipmaker reported Q3 financial results exceeding Wall Street expectations. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $0.21 per share on $57.3 million in revenue compared with the Capital IQ consensus expecting a $0.09 per share non-GAAP profit on $57.2 million in revenue.
In other sector news:
(+) Workday ( WDAY ) jumped more than 8% during Friday's early session after reporting a surprise increase in Q3 net income compared with the year-ago period, rising to $0.31 per share during the three months ended Oct. 31 from $0.24 per share and easily beating the Capital IQ consensus expecting a year-over-year drop to $0.14 per share. Revenue climbed 33.8% to $743.2 million, also surpassing the $723.4 million analyst mean.
(-) Amtech Systems ( ASYS ) was down 10% in Friday pre-market after Thursday reporting a $0.61 per share fiscal Q4 net loss for the three months ended Sept. 30, versus a profit of $0.51 per share during the year-ago period and missing the Capital IQ consensus expecting a $0.17 per share net loss. Looking forward, the solar-cell components company also is projecting fiscal Q1 revenue in a range of $27 million to $29 million, lagging the analyst mean by at least $3.1 million.
